reference.title: Managed preference locking reference
reference.shortdesc: Managed preferences are exported through the Firefox Preferences policy and need explicit value, type, and status review.

section.title: Container policy
section.p: Firefox stores managed preferences under Preferences. BPM documents known preferences separately but exports them as entries in that container policy.

section.title: Status values
section.p: locked prevents user changes where Firefox supports the preference. default, user, and clear have different runtime meanings and should not be used as synonyms.

section.title: Type values
section.p: Set Type to boolean, number, or string when BPM needs an exact value shape. The Value type must match the declared type.

section.title: Source conflicts
section.p: A preference can come from a preset, CIS layer, import, manual edit, or raw fallback. Review the source before locking because a locked preference can override user expectation more strongly than an unlocked policy default.

section.title: Safe review
section.p: Validate both Release and ESR when a profile may be reused across channels, and keep preference IDs unchanged. BPM can validate the container shape but Firefox runtime decides the final effect.
